title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派12番外假如朔衡变成反派11
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
朔衡探出的神识像是一张无形的大网，将数里范围之内的火山残骸，尽数笼罩。
但除了数不清的怪物和火山岩浆，他还没见到任何其他能让他发现一线生机的东西。
高天之中，剑雨倾盆。
灵气化刃在朔衡的掌控下锋锐无比，眼下冲上来的这些怪物在他手里根本撑不过一回合。
可从神识反馈得知，这片天地之间的危险远不止于此。
单说那些暗处更加隐晦磅礴的气息，
朔衡猜测，或许实力还在圣境之上。
若是引起了这些家伙的注意，他就算有三头六臂，也难以抵抗半圣、帝境、乃至更高层次之间的天堑。
朔衡思虑，只在弹指一挥间。
但强者的战场中，有时一瞬间就能致使整场战局改变。
在朔衡神识偶然间探触到某个隐匿在火山中的突兀洞穴时，
那些一直围在他身侧的怪物也有一位圣境实力成功突破了剑雨的阻隔，扇动着那双赤色与黑暗交织的翅膀，朝朔衡所在的方向俯冲而来。
朔衡目光一厉，背后瞬间展开雪白鹤羽。
风之意境，白鹤归天！
唰——
伴随一阵破风声，朔衡的身影直冲云霄，
把圣境怪物来势汹汹的一击，险而又险的避了过去。
但撕扯的风刃，还是在他身上留下了一些不痛不痒的伤口。
见了血，那些怪物就更疯了。
朔衡的目光若有所思的看了一眼洞穴的方向，又再度转回眼前战场。

无论如何，至少不能让这些家伙跟得太紧，
他得给自己创造一个脱离怪物视野的机会。
正想着，那一击落空的圣境怪物再次扑杀过来！
说到底，它也是圣境。
意念一动，整片脚下矗立的火山与其上蜿蜒的岩浆长河竟同时沸腾起来，卷起的火焰缭绕四方，
隐隐形成包夹之势，将朔衡困于其中。
火焰燃烧的温度极高，
更何况，这里本就是朱雀的“老家”，不灭火山四个字从何而来，甚至都无需用言语去解释。
朔衡周身泛起青紫色的灵光，将滔天热浪阻挡在外，而他本人则随手挽了个剑花，
毫无暂避锋芒之心的、对准了圣境怪物的方向。
太虚剑游，共有三式。
content_en:
The consciousness that Shuo Heng detected was like a large invisible net, covering all the volcanic debris within a few miles.
But apart from countless monsters and volcanic lava, he hasn't seen anything else that would allow him to find a glimmer of hope.
In the high sky, sword rain poured down.
The spiritual energy blade was extremely sharp under Shuo Heng's control, and the monsters rushing up at the moment simply couldn't survive a round in his hands.
It can be known from the feedback from the spiritual consciousness that the dangers in this world are far more than this.
Just talking about the more obscure and majestic atmosphere in the darkness,
Shuo Heng guessed that perhaps his strength was still above the holy realm.
If he attracts the attention of these guys, even if he has three heads and six arms, he will not be able to resist the chasm between the semi-saint, the imperial realm, and even higher levels.
Shuo Heng thought about it with just a snap of his fingers.
But in the battlefield of the strong, sometimes the whole situation of the battle can change in an instant.
When Shuo Heng's spiritual consciousness accidentally explored an unexpected cave hidden in the volcano,
Among the monsters that had been surrounding him, one of the saint-level monsters successfully broke through the barrier of the sword rain, flapped his red and dark wings, and swooped in the direction of Shuo Heng.
Shuo Heng's eyes sharpened, and snow-white crane feathers instantly spread out from his back.
The artistic conception of wind, the white crane returns to heaven!
Swish——
With a burst of wind, Shuo Heng's figure soared into the sky,
He narrowly avoided the menacing blow from the holy monster.
But the tearing wind blade still left some painless wounds on his body.
Seeing blood made those monsters even crazier.
Shuo Heng glanced thoughtfully in the direction of the cave, then turned back to the battlefield in front of him.
No matter what, at least we can't let these guys follow too closely.
He had to create a chance for himself to escape from the monster's sight.
Just as he was thinking about it, the holy monster that missed the attack came over again!
After all, it is also a holy place.
With a thought, the entire volcano standing at the foot and the meandering magma river boiled at the same time, and the rolled up flames spread in all directions.
There was a faint tendency to outflank Shuo Heng, trapping him in it.
The flame burns at extremely high temperatures,
What's more, this is Suzaku's "hometown". Where the words "Eternal Volcano" come from, there is no need to explain it in words.
Shuo Heng's whole body glowed with a purple aura, blocking out the overwhelming heat wave, while he himself held a sword flower casually,
Without any intention of avoiding the sharp edge, he aimed in the direction of the holy monster.
Taixu Jianyou has three styles in total.
